card.name: Right after units in dosing formulas
card.fires_on: The first word or symbol right after a lab value, unit or formula term in a dose table or calculation, such as 'No' after /L or ng/dL, or '[' after g/dL. It also fires on letters inside dose-calculation formulas.

modes.label: Table cell after a lab threshold
modes.description: The word 'No' or a bracket that follows a lab value with its unit, starting the action column.
modes.example: count ≥ 25 x 10 9 /L and nadir ANC ≥ 0.5 x 10 9 /L<< No>> Change Nadir ANC < 0.
